India march forward in style!
The Indian Men’s Hockey Team put on a dominant, high-octane display to secure a clinical 4-2 win over Malaysia. Skipper Harmanpreet Singh led from the front with a sensational hat-trick, while Sukhjeet Singh chipped in with a crucial goal to seal a commanding win for Team India!
